content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal is a single insert_after operation adding Section 9.4 after 9.3, carrying only the four preferred elements (Customer convenience right, 30 days' written notice, pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, no Vendor convenience right during a committed term). The Section 2.1 rewrite and the extra words ("in whole or in part", "without penalty or early-termination charge") were removed, and the official minimality gate and precision checks now pass.
